records.english:
<currencyitem>{Edit Mode Controls:}
To move an object, drag it or press the arrow keys.
To rotate an object, drag between the two circles or press R/Shift+R.
To flip an object, select it and press F.
To change the variation of a decoration, use the mousewheel or press Page Up/Page Down.
To copy an object, right-click it then left-click to place a copy of it.
To reclaim an object, select it and press Delete.
<b>{When finished, click the Edit button}

欲移動一個物品，請拖曳它或是使用方向鍵來操作。

欲改變一個物品呈現方式，滾動滑鼠滾輪或是按下 Page Up / Page Down。

records.english: Complete the six Trials of Ascendancy scattered throughout Wraeclast to earn access to the Lord's Labyrinth. Upon completing the Labyrinth and defeating Emperor Izaro, you can choose an Ascendancy class. Completing each Labyrinth for the first time rewards you with two Ascendancy points and the ability to imbue a piece of equipment with a special enchantment. The Labyrinth's layout and secrets change every day.

技能寶石 I：基礎知識

records.english:
In Path of Exile, all of your skills (other than your default attack) come from items called 'skill gems'. Skill gems must be socketed into your equipped weapons and armour in order for you to be able to use the skill they grant. It doesn't matter which item the gem is socketed into, but the socket has to match the colour of the gem. In other words, red skill gems can go in red sockets, and can't go in blue or green sockets.

Support gems work very similarly to skill gems, except they don't grant you a skill by themselves. Instead, support gems can augment the skill gems they are linked to. Not all skill and support gems work together; You can't use a 'Melee Physical Damage Support' with a spell, for example.
records.zhTW:
在流亡黯道中，你的所有技能(除了普通攻擊)都是來自於「技能寶石」。要使用技能的能力，一定要將技能寶石鑲嵌於武器和裝備的插槽中。技能寶石無論插在哪個物品上都可以發揮效果，但一定要鑲嵌於同樣顏色的插槽中。舉例：紅色的技能寶石只能鑲嵌於紅色的插槽中，無法鑲嵌於藍色或綠色的插槽。

輔助寶石與技能寶石使用方法很相似，但它們無法直接給與你輔助效果。輔助寶石可以增強與他相連的技能寶石。並不是所有技能都可以和輔助寶石發揮效果。舉例：近戰物理傷害輔助與法術技能無法發揮效果。

records.english:
For a support gem to properly augment a skill gem, both the skill and support gems must be socketed in linked sockets. If they aren't linked, the support will have no effect.

You can tell whether or not your support gem is affecting your skill gem by looking at the on-screen skill icon. Properly linked support gems add a little letter to the skill icon on the user interface. Most support gems also change the mana cost of the skills they're supporting.
records.zhTW:
要讓輔助寶石增強技能寶石，兩者寶石插槽必須要相連。若插槽沒有相連，則輔助寶石將無法發揮效果。

你可以透過技能快捷鍵的視窗中確認輔助寶石是否有發揮效果。有效的輔助寶石會於技能圖示中顯示一個小字母。大多數的輔助寶石都會增加輔助技能的魔力消耗。

records.english: You can add or remove your skill and support gems at any time, so don't be afraid to experiment with strange gem combinations.
records.zhTW: 你可以在任何時候增加或移除技能和輔助寶石，所以不要害怕嘗試各種寶石組合唷。

records.english: Skill Gems II: Requirements and Restrictions
records.zhTW: 技能寶石 II：需求與限制

records.english: Support and skill gems, like other items, have level and attribute requirements. Unlike other items, gems can level up, and when a gem levels up, its level and attribute requirements can change. If you level a gem past the point that you can use it, or if your attributes change and disable a gem, the entire item the gem is socketed in will also be disabled. That means it's worth checking whether or not you should level up gems that don't require your primary attributes. Sometimes it's better not to level up a gem!
records.zhTW: 輔助和技能寶石和其他物品一樣，有等級和能力的需求。但與其他物品不同的是，寶石可以升等，當寶石升等後，它的等級和能力需求都會改變。如果你將寶石升級至你無法使用的等級，或是你的能力改變導致寶石失效，則你鑲嵌寶石的物品將會失去能力。這表示在升級寶石前，務必確認自己的等級和能力是否符合寶石升級後的需求。所以有時候最好別升級寶石呀!

records.english: You may find that you want to use the same support gem for multiple skills. Simply socket that support in the same item as the skills you wish to support and make sure they are all linked. The support gem doesn't have to be adjacent to the skill gems you want to support; they just have to all be part of the same group of linked sockets. You may also find that you want the same skill to be supported by multiple support gems. The requirements for this are the same.
records.zhTW: 你可能會發現你想要使用相同的輔助寶石輔助許多技能。你可以將你想要輔助的技能都鑲嵌於輔助技能所在的物品中，但請確認物品插槽都是相連。輔助的技能不用與輔助寶石相鄰一樣可以獲得輔助寶石的效果。你可能也會發現你的技能想要被多個輔助寶石輔助，則使用的方使與上述相同。

records.english: Some support gems will significantly change the way the supported skills behave. A spell supported by the 'Spell Totem' support will now summon a totem to cast the spell for you, and you won't be able to cast the spell yourself. The same is true for the 'Trap' support and the two Mine supports, 'High-Impact Mine' and 'Blastchain Mine.'
records.zhTW: 有些輔助寶石會改變被輔助技能的型式。法術技能被「法術圖騰」輔助時，則將會召喚一個圖騰施放此法術，而你無法再使用此法術。同樣的道理可以套用在陷阱與連鎖爆破地雷、高能地雷輔助。

records.english: Some support gems can be used to trigger a skill automatically. The 'Cast on Critical Strike Support' gem casts the spells it is supporting whenever you get a critical strike with an attack it is also supporting. Any spell supported this way can only be triggered and can no longer be cast manually, similar to how the Spell Totem Support works. Skills being supported by multiple trigger gems won't work at all. Keep this in mind when deciding which skills and supports you want to use.
records.zhTW: 有些輔助寶石可以自動觸發技能。「暴擊時施放輔助」寶石將會在你攻擊暴擊時，自動施放輔助的技能。當技能被此類型寶石輔助時，只能被觸發無法在手動施放，就像是法術圖騰一樣。請謹記在心此技能串法喔。

records.english: A skill gem's features can change when it levels up, including the requirements to use it.
records.zhTW: 某些技能寶石隨著等級提升，功能將會改變，當然也包括使用需求。

records.english:
Your character build is primarily composed of the items the character is wearing, the skill and support gems that are socketed within those items, and the passive skills you have chosen from the passive skill tree. Because the passive skill tree lays the groundwork for your items and gems, the passive skill tree is arguably the core of every character build. 

Whenever you level up, and upon completing certain quests, you'll get a passive skill point. Each point can be allocated on the passive skill tree to gain the benefits of the passive skill (often referred to as a 'passive') it is spent on.

You can only allocate points on passives that are connected to your other allocated passives. There are far, far more passive skills on the tree than you can ever allocate, so you need to think carefully about what you want to choose. It is often worth planning ahead.

There are three types of passive skill:
records.zhTW:
你的角色流派主要是由你角色所穿的裝備、使用的技能和輔助寶石和你所選擇的天賦組成。天賦樹的鋪成會為你的裝備和寶石作為基礎，所以天賦樹是每個角色流派的核心。

當你升等或是完成某些任務時，你都可以獲得一點天賦點。每個天賦點都可以從天賦樹中獲得你所配置天賦的效果。

你只能配置與先前已配置過的天賦點相鄰的天賦。天賦樹中有相當多的天賦，多到你無法全部都配置，所以每一步路都要想清楚。最好先前就做好規劃。

天賦一共有三種類型：

records.english: Many clusters on the passive tree have 'Masteries' at their centres which signify the type of passives that cluster grants. Allocating any Notable in a cluster with a Mastery grants access to the 'Mastery passive.' Mastery passives provide a selection of one of many special stats related to the Mastery theme (e.g. Fire or Bow). Like regular passives, Masteries require a passive point to allocate. Mastery passives are shared across the tree, so Fire Masteries everywhere give the same selection of special stats. Special stats cannot be allocated more than once.
records.zhTW: 許多聚在一起的天賦中間帶有圖樣，意味著那區天賦的功能。如果你正找尋類似功能的天賦，可以利用圖示來分辨。

records.english:
The passive skill tree also contains jewel sockets. An allocated jewel socket can hold a jewel, but won't grant any sort of benefit by itself. Jewels cannot interact with Masteries.

The edges of the passive skill tree are also home to Large jewel sockets, these can hold Cluster jewels as well as regular jewels.
records.zhTW:
天賦樹中包含了珠寶插槽。配置到珠寶插槽時，可以裝備一個珠寶，但裝備珠寶前不會獲得任何效果。珠寶不會與專精互動。

天賦樹邊緣同時也是巨型珠寶插槽的所在，這些插槽可以放置星團珠寶或一般珠寶。

records.english:
The tree is shared by all of the character classes, but each class begins in a different location. Learning what is near each starting location will help you plan out future characters.

You can undo your choices with the passive refund points you get from certain quests and from using Orbs of Regret. You can only undo a single point per refund point, so if you plan on making changes later, make sure you can afford to do so.
records.zhTW:
天賦樹與所有職業共用，但每個職業的起始點位置都不相同。知道每個起始點附近的天賦有助於你之後角色的養成。

你可以使用天賦重置點回收已配置的天賦，每點天賦重置點只能收回一點天賦，所以在使用前請先確認是否有足夠的重置點喔。(天賦重置點可透過某些任務、後悔石取得或於商城購買)

records.english: Items, monsters, strongboxes, and later even maps, can all have different rarities. Something's rarity determines what properties it has. Generally, something that is 'magic' is stronger than something that is 'normal', and something that is 'rare' is stronger than something that is 'magic'. This is achieved through random modifiers, or 'mods'.
records.zhTW: 物品、怪物、寶顯相和地圖都可以有不同的稀有度。物品的稀有度決定它有多少效能。一般來說，「魔法物品」會比「普通物品」還強。「稀有物品」則會比「魔法物品」強。這是因為物品上的隨機「詞綴」。

records.english: Rarity determines how many mods something can have. Magic rarity typically imbues something with either one or two mods, while most rares can get up to six.
records.zhTW: 稀有度決定了物品可以有多少詞綴。魔法物品通常只能獲得1至2個詞綴，而稀有物品至多可以獲得6個詞綴。

records.english:
If you're lucky, you may also find something that is of 'unique' rarity. Unique items always have the same mods, but those mods can be very different to the ones you find on magics and rares.

For example, this unique staff changes how your projectiles work:
records.zhTW:
如果你夠幸運，你可以發現傳奇稀有度的物品。傳奇道具的詞綴都一樣，但這些詞綴都會與魔法和稀有道具非常不同。

舉例來說，傳奇物品可以改變你的投射物運作方式：

records.english: Many unique items come with a downside, or provide specialised or conditional power without staple mods, such as elemental resistances or life. As a result, using many unique items doesn't necessarily always benefit you! Unique items also have their own special art, names and flavour text.
records.zhTW: 許多傳奇物品都會有缺點，或是提供某方面強大的能力而不提供基礎詞綴，像是元素抗性或生命。所以並不是使用傳奇裝備就可以讓自己變強!傳奇物品都會有自己專屬的美術圖和寓意文。

records.english: When people talk about 'uniques', they are usually referring to unique items, but there are also unique strongboxes, maps, and monsters throughout Path of Exile. Major content updates usually includes a number of new uniques.
records.zhTW: 當大家提到「傳奇」時，多半是在講傳奇裝備，但流亡黯道中還有傳奇保險箱、傳奇地圖和傳奇怪物。大改版時通常都會有許多新的傳奇道具。

records.english: Normal, Magic, Rare and Unique rarities are indicated by the colour of the name.
records.zhTW: 普通、魔法、稀有和傳奇稀有度可以使用顏色區別。

records.english: Each rarity tier has certain properties.
records.zhTW: 每個稀有度都有某些效果。

records.english: Some unique items provide utility at the cost of raw stats, or only fully work when certain conditions are met.
records.zhTW: 有些傳奇物品只能在原始狀態下才能發揮效果，或是達成某些條件。

records.english: Stats and Mods I: How Are They Calculated?
records.zhTW: 數值和詞綴 I：如何計算？

records.english: Your Path of Exile character is primarily built from a combination of passive skills, skill gems, and items. Both the passive tree and the items can seem overwhelming at first, so in this tutorial we will cover some of the basics.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道的角色流派，主要由天賦、技能寶石和裝備組合而成。天賦樹和裝備乍看之下可能會使人感到無助，故在此引導中，我們將介紹相關的基礎知識讓流亡者們了解。

records.english: The most important thing to know is how the passive tree interacts with your character. In general, passive skills affect all the relevant stats on your character, regardless of where they come from. We call these global modifiers.
records.zhTW: 你一定要知道你的天賦對你的角色有什麼效果。一般來說，天賦影響到角色所有有關的能力，無論他的來源是什麼。我們可以稱呼這些為「全域詞綴」。

records.english: In the example above, we see that the 'increased maximum life' passives add together before they affect the character's life. Most passive skills, especially any that use the word 'increased', act this way.
records.zhTW: 從上面的例子，增加最大生命的天賦會先全部加總，再增加到角色的生命。大多數的天賦都是這樣運作的。

records.english: Passives that specifically say they grant 'more' or 'less' of something are the exceptions to the above rule. These are applied after all of the increases, acting like multipliers. Unlike passives which increase something, passives which provide 'more' or 'less' of something never add together and instead each apply their multiplicative effect separately. These terms appear on Keystones in the passive skill tree, but are most commonly seen on support gems.
records.zhTW: 如果天賦中有特別說明獲得「更多」或「更少」什麼的話，則不是用此規則。這將會於加總全部的增加詞綴後再套用此詞綴，像是加成的效果。不像增加詞綴會先加總，「更多」或「更少」詞綴會用相乘的方式計算。在輔助寶石上很常見此方式。

records.english: Item mods tend to come in two varieties: 'global mods', which act like the passive skills, and 'local mods', which affect the item itself. Compare the weapons below, and note that the magic weapon (on the right) has 'Increased Physical Damage'. You'll see that the weapon's Physical Damage is higher, and is a different colour. It is this number that is used when other modifiers, such as your passive skills, are used to calculate how much damage your attacks deal.
records.zhTW: 物品詞綴會有兩種分類：「全域」詞綴作用方式與天賦一樣，而「區域」詞綴則只會作用於裝備本身。比較下列的武器，並且注意魔法武器(右邊)有「增加物理傷害」詞綴。你可以看到這件武器的物理攻擊比較高而且是不同顏色。這表示數字被其他詞綴作用，像是你的天賦，這將會計算出你的攻擊造成多傷害。

records.english:
The same is true for increases to armour on items that naturally provide armour, or increases to evasion on items that naturally provide evasion, and so on.  
			
Some mods, such as 'Increased Attack Speed', can appear on both weapons and armour. Like the Increased Physical Damage modifier, the Increased Attack Speed on the weapon shown below is local to the weapon, and changes that specific weapon's rate of attack. The gloves shown below also have Increased Attack Speed, but they affect any weapon you are holding and use the Attacks Per Second value displayed on the weapon to calculate how quickly you attack.
records.zhTW:
物品上有增加護甲詞綴和增加閃避詞綴就是直接增加護甲和閃避。

例如「增加攻擊速度」詞綴會出現在武器和護甲上。像增加物理傷害詞綴，武器上的增加攻擊速度詞綴，只會作用於此武器上改變武器的攻擊速度。手套若是有增加攻擊速度詞綴，他們會作用於任何你裝備的武器，並且將計算出來的攻擊速度呈現在武器上。

records.english:
The attack speed mod on these gloves is a global modifier, so it adds together with other global increases to attack speed, including those on your passive tree.
 
As a general rule (though there are occasional exceptions), if the values in the top section of an item are different to the normal basetype, they are benefitting from local modifiers. If a modifier on an item doesn't seem to be affecting anything in the top section, then it is global.

See if you can work out which mods are local and which mods are global in the image below.
records.zhTW:
手套上攻擊速度詞綴是全域詞綴，所以它會先與其他的全域增加攻擊速度詞綴加總，包括在天賦樹上的詞綴。

一般來說(雖然會有些例外:P)，

records.english: This character has been granted life from their Iron Ring, as well as from their first passive skill. They also gained life simply by levelling up.
records.zhTW: 此角色透過鍛鐵戒指和起初的天賦獲得生命。也可以透過升等獲得生命。

records.english: By taking these two passive skills, this character also gains 4% and 5% increased maximum life. These add to a total of 9% increased maximum life.
records.zhTW: 取得這兩點天賦點，此角色獲得 4% 和 5% 最大生命。總共增加 9% 最大生命。

records.english: The global modifier (increased maximum life) increases all sources of maximum life, and after rounding, we land on this character's final life value.
records.zhTW: 全域詞綴（增加生命）會增加所有生命的來源，在四捨五入後決定角色的生命值。

records.english: The Full Scale Armour has one local mod (increased Armour and Evasion) and one global mod (Lightning Resistance). The Steel Gauntlets also have one local mod (increased Armour) and one global mod (increased Attack Speed). The Sharktooth Claw's increased Attack Speed mod is local, and so is the implicit (life gained on hit).
records.zhTW: 連身鱗甲擁有一條區域詞綴(增加護甲和閃避)和一條全域詞綴(閃電抗性)。冷鋼護手擁有一條區域詞綴(增加護甲)和一條全域詞綴(增加攻擊速度)。鯊顎爪的增加攻擊速度詞綴為區域詞綴，固定詞綴也是屬於區域詞綴（擊中回復生命）。

records.english: Glossary of Common Game and Player Terms
A section of Path of Exile's main story. Each act has a Town, quests, and a story arc contained within it.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道主線故事的一部分。每章節都會有一個城鎮、任務和自己的故事。

records.english: Any skill that performs an action is an active skill. Most skill gems provide you with an active skill.
records.zhTW: 只要技能有呈現動作就是主動技能。每個技能寶石，甚至一些輔助寶時都會提供你主動技能。

records.english: The modifiers (or mods) that are randomly assigned to items. A magic item can have two affixes; one prefix and one suffix. Most rare items can have six; three prefixes and three suffixes.
records.zhTW: 詞綴會隨機配置於物品中。魔法物品最多可以有兩個詞綴；一個前綴和一個後綴。稀有物品最多可以有六個詞綴；三個前綴和三個後綴。

records.english: [Bleeding], [Ignite], [Chill], [Freeze], [Shock] and [Poison]. [Ailments] can be removed by certain charms, or negated by items or passive skills.
records.zhTW: [Bleeding|流血]、[Ignite|點燃]、[Chill|冰緩]、[Freeze|冰凍]、[Shock|感電]和[Poison|中毒]。[Ailments|異常狀態]可利用特定護符去除，或以物品或天賦減輕。

records.english: The area in which a skill has an effect. A fireball's explosion has a small area of effect, while the secondary effect of Earthquake has a large area of effect.
records.zhTW: 技能於範圍內作用。火球技能爆炸時會造成小的範圍效果。地震技能的二階段有大的範圍效果。

records.english: The primary defensive stat from Strength-based equipment. Armour reduces the damage taken from physical attack and spell hits.
records.zhTW: 力量基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為護甲。護甲會減少物理攻擊和法術擊中時所造成的傷害。

records.english: A specialised subclass unlocked via the Labyrinth.
records.zhTW: 透過帝王迷宮所解鎖的特殊副職業。

records.english: One of the main skill types. With few exceptions, attacks use your weapon to calculate damage. Any skill gem with the "Attack" tag is an attack. Attacks can be both ranged and melee, and items and passive skills can affect ranged attacks or melee attacks exclusively. Some attacks, such as Spectral Throw, use a melee weapon but are not considered melee.
records.zhTW: 主要技能類型之一。任何技能寶石標有「攻擊」標籤則為此類型技能。攻擊技能有遠距離和近戰，道具和天賦都可以分別影響這兩個類型。有些攻擊技能，像「靈體投擲」雖然使用近戰武器，但就不被列為近戰技能。

records.english: Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. Most items have an attribute requirement.
records.zhTW: 力量、敏捷、智力。大多數的物品都會有能力值的需求。

records.english: A persistent field of an effect. If you step outside of an aura's radius, you won't be affected by it. Auras are also a specific set of skills that frequently reserve a portion of mana.
records.zhTW: 在範圍內會一直作用效果。如果踏出光環範圍外，就不再獲得光環的效果。使用光環時通常都會需要魔力保存。

records.english: A group of monsters that are summoned, under certain conditions, when many enemies are slain in close proximity.
records.zhTW: 在某些特定狀態下，當擊殺成群的敵人，可以召喚出一群強大的怪物。

records.english: A strong unique enemy. Every non-unique map has one or more map bosses, and every act has one or more act bosses.
records.zhTW: 一個強大的傳奇敵人。每張非傳奇地圖都會有一隻或更多頭目。每個章節也都會有一隻或更多章節頭目。

records.english: Visible as a clawed hand reaching out of the ground. Breaches grow in size and fill with monsters for a period of time. The more monsters slain within a breach, the longer the breach will remain open and continue to grow in size.
records.zhTW: 像個魔爪從地面伸出來。啟動後裂痕範圍會成長，且範圍內充滿了裂痕怪物。擊殺越多的裂痕怪物，裂痕開啟的時間就會越長，直至最大範圍。

records.english: The way a character is played or intended to be played. Eg. A Tornado Shot build uses Tornado shot as its primary skill, and most of the items and passive skills serve to improve the effectiveness of Tornado Shot.
records.zhTW: 角色進行遊戲的方式和玩法。例如：龍捲射擊流派使用龍捲射擊技能做為主要攻擊技能，而使用的道具和天賦大多是來增強龍捲射擊的威力。

records.english: One of the five damage types, along with Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning. Chaos damage bypasses Energy Shield by default.
records.zhTW: 和火焰、冰冷、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。混沌傷害將無視能量護盾。

records.english: Usually refers to the Marauder, Duelist, Ranger, Shadow, Witch, Templar and Scion playable characters.
records.zhTW: 一般指野蠻人、女巫、遊俠、聖騎士、決鬥者、暗影刺客、貴族、七位可遊玩角色。

records.english:
May refer to one of several things: Frenzy, Endurance, and Power Charges, which can be gained from items or skills, and which grant significant boosts to damage and attack/cast speed, damage reduction and resistances, and critical strike chance respectively. 

Charge may also refer to Flask charges, which determine how many uses a flask has. Flask charges are regained primarily by slaying monsters.

Charge can also reference the number of uses a skill has, such as some trap skills or Vaal skills that can store enough souls for multiple uses.
records.zhTW:
一般意旨能透過物品、技能、天賦效果獲得的「狂怒球」、「耐力球」、「暴擊球」。它們能夠提供給你大量的能力強化，像是：傷害、攻擊/施法速度、傷害減免、抗性、暴擊率。

充能同時也可能意旨藥水的充能，主要用於判斷該藥水能夠使用的次數。回復藥水充能的主要方法為擊殺怪物。

最後，充能也可能意指某個技能在短時間內能夠使用的次數。

records.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Lightning, Physical and Chaos. Cold damage can chill and freeze by default.
records.zhTW: 和火焰、混沌、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。冰冷傷害能夠冰凍、冰緩敵人。

records.english: One of the mysterious forces that is causing the dead to rise and life to mutate on Wraeclast. Also refers to the act of using a Vaal Orb on an item to change its properties. A corrupted item cannot be further modified.
records.zhTW: 散佈於瓦爾克拉斯的神祕能量，使死者復甦，生者突變。同時意旨使用「瓦爾寶珠」在物品上使其汙染的動作。已汙染的物品將無法進一步修改屬性。

records.english: The act of changing or creating an item. This can be done through the use of the various Orbs, Essences and Hideout crafting benches.
records.zhTW: 無論是使用通貨、精髓、工藝台來創造或修改物品屬性皆屬於工藝製作。

records.english: Usually refers to the various Orb items such as the Chaos Orb.
records.zhTW: 一般意旨遊戲中各式各樣的「石頭」，例如：混沌石、崇高石、瓦爾寶珠、護甲片、磨刀石、點金石等等。

records.english: An alternate Defence introduced in the Expedition League. Ward intercepts an amount of Damage taken from a single Hit, up to the total amount of Ward you have, before that Damage would be taken from your Energy Shield or Life. When this happens, Ward Breaks, and will be Restored after a short delay. Ward has no effect on further Hits while it remains Broken, but such Hits will also not reset the delay before it is Restored.
records.zhTW: 在探險聯盟中引進的替代防禦手段。保護在從你的能量護盾或生命中受到傷害之前，會攔截一次擊中受到的一定量的傷害，最多為你擁有的保護總數。發生這種情況時，保護會破壞，並在一段時間後恢復。保護在保持破碎狀態時對進一步的命中沒有影響，但此類命中在恢復之前也不會重置延遲。

records.english: Damage that occurs over a period of time without a 'hit'. Eg. Standing on burning ground, or the poison component of Viper Strike.
records.zhTW: 任何在特定時間內持續發生的傷害。延伸參考：消耗傷害

records.english:
Armour, Energy Shield and Evasion are the three main defences. These are found on most non-weapon equippable items.

Ward is also a defence, and can be found on certain pieces of armour obtained from Expeditions and the Iron Flask.
records.zhTW:
護甲、能量護盾、閃避為主要的三種防禦手段。能夠在大多非武器物品上取得。

保護也是防禦機制，可以從探險護甲上和鋼鐵藥劑尚發現。

records.english: One of the three attributes, along with Strength and Intelligence. Dexterity passively grants some Accuracy and increases your Evasion.
records.zhTW: 和力量與智力一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。敏捷能夠提升你的角色命中和閃避數值。

records.english: A type of item that can be turned in at Tasuni in Highgate or Lilly Roth in your Hideout for the reward written on the card. Each of these was designed by a Path of Exile supporter.
records.zhTW: 此類型道具在收集指定數量後可以與統治者之殿中的達蘇尼或你藏身處的莉莉羅斯兌換該卡片上敘述的獎勵。每一張卡片都是由流亡黯道的贊助者所設計。

records.english: The primary defensive stat from Intelligence-based equipment. Energy Shield protects Life from all damage types except Chaos by default. Energy Shield also rapidly recovers after a period of taking no damage.
records.zhTW: 智力基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為能量護盾。能量護盾會保護生命值不受到任何除了混沌傷害以外的傷害。能量護盾在沒有受到傷害一段時間後會迅速的恢復。

records.english: Weapons, shields, helmets, body armours, boots, gloves, rings, amulets, and belts all count as equipment.
records.zhTW: 武器、盾牌、頭盔、胸甲、鞋子、手套、戒指、項鍊、腰帶都屬於裝備。

records.english: The primary defensive stat from Dexterity-based equipment. Evasion provides a chance to ignore incoming attacks. Evasion provides no benefit against spells.
records.zhTW: 敏捷基底的裝備主要的防禦手段為閃避值。閃避值提供能夠無視攻擊的機率，閃避值對法術無效。

records.english: Any NPC who was exiled from Oriath. Each of the player characters is also an Exile.
records.zhTW: 任何被奧瑞亞逐出的人，玩家也屬於流亡者。

records.english: One of the five damage types, along with Cold, Lightning, Physical and Chaos. Fire damage can ignite by default.
records.zhTW: 和冰冷、混沌、閃電、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。火焰傷害能夠點燃敵人。

records.english: An item type that sits in the flask slots and is used to gain some effect on the player character, such as restoring life or mana, or gaining a temporary buff. Flasks are refilled by slaying monsters, or returning to a Town or Hideout.
records.zhTW: 放置於藥水欄位的道具，不同的藥水在使用後能獲得不同的效果。擊殺、返回城鎮、藏身處皆可回復藥水的充能。

records.english: The Town in Act 2 that is sitting atop the river.
records.zhTW: 第二章中坐落於河川上游。

records.english: May refer to Skill Gems or Support Gems. Not to be confused with Jewels.
records.zhTW: 意旨技能寶石或者輔助寶石。和珠寶不同。

records.english: A mod which affects more than just the item it is on.
records.zhTW: 影響範圍不限於所屬道具的詞綴。

records.english: A collection of players that have access to a shared chat channel and a shared stash. Guilds can also have Guild Tags, a sequence of letters that represents which guild they are a part of.
records.zhTW: 一群意志相投的玩家，共享同一個聊天頻道和倉庫。工會可以設定公會標籤，代表他們所屬的工會。

records.english: An area owned by the player that can house Masters and crafting benches, and can be decorated and altered by the player. Hideouts are shared across all characters on the same league and account.
records.zhTW: 玩家自有的空間，能夠自行布置，收留大師和他們的工藝桌。每個聯盟的藏身處是互通的。

records.english: Any object that can be moved and placed within a Hideout.
records.zhTW: 任何能夠在藏身處中擺設的道具。

records.english: The Town on Mount Veruso, first encountered in Act 4.
records.zhTW: 位於第四章節的主要城鎮。

records.english: The mod that appears above the randomly generated mods on an item. This is guaranteed by the basetype that the implicit is on, but can be changed by a few different sources. The most common way to change an implicit is by using a Vaal Orb (see Corruption).
records.zhTW: 顯示於物品隨機生成詞綴上方的固定屬性，這條詞綴會根據不同類型的物品而定。雖然一般來說是固定的，但流亡黯道中存在能更改固定詞綴的方式，例如：瓦爾寶珠（參考：腐化汙染）

records.english: One of the three attributes, along with Strength and Dexterity. Intelligence passively grants some Mana and increases your Energy Shield.
records.zhTW: 和敏捷與力量一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。智力能夠提升你的角色魔力和能量護盾。

records.english: An item that can be socketed in the passive tree.
records.zhTW: 一種能夠鑲入天賦樹的物品類型。

records.english: Usually refers to rings and amulets. Sometimes also includes belts and jewels.
records.zhTW: 一般指戒指、項鍊、腰帶、寶珠。

records.english: One of the very large passive skills on the passive tree. Keystones drastically change the function of your character, and often come with a drawback.
records.zhTW: 天賦樹中最顯眼的一系列天賦點，會從根本上改變一個角色的戰鬥風格以及各項配置。 它通常會有一項正面的增益效果，並搭配上一項負面的減益效果。

records.english: A long, difficult dungeon that grants the player Ascendancy points upon completion. The layout changes every day.
records.zhTW: 困難且複雜的迷宮，完成後能夠獲得昇華點數。迷宮的配置隨每日改變。

records.english: Usually refers to items that have mods, mod values or other features that cannot be obtained through normal means anymore. May refer to the Legacy challenge league, which ran in 2017.
records.zhTW: 所謂古典道具，是指該道具擁有目前已經無法再取得的詞綴。

records.english: Players and some items have levels, used to track the progress or strength of a range of features.
records.zhTW: 玩家和某些物品有等級，主要用來分辨進度或者強度。

records.english: Determines whether your character is alive or dead. If your life falls to zero, you're dead.
records.zhTW: 決定你的角色生死，若你的生命消耗至零，你將會死亡。

records.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Cold, Physical and Chaos. Lightning damage can shock by default.
records.zhTW: 和冰冷、火焰、混沌、物理傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。閃電傷害能夠使敵人感電。

records.english: The bridge between two sockets on an item, that allows skill gems to be supported by support gems.
records.zhTW: 物品上插槽與插槽間的橋梁，使輔助技能寶石和技能寶石能夠互相影響。

records.english: The remains of a fortress that now acts as the Town in Act 1.
records.zhTW: 壁壘的殘骸現在為第一章節的城鎮。

records.english: Any mod that only affects the properties of the item it is on, and not the character as a whole.
records.zhTW: 任何只影響物品上屬性而非整體角色的詞綴。

records.english: A keyword that denotes that a mechanic that has some randomness will be checked twice, and the best outcome of the two checks will be used.
records.zhTW: 所謂幸運，是指某個變數在系統隨機產生兩次結果後，選擇使用對流亡者較有利的結果。

records.english: One of the tiers of rarity. Things that are of Magic rarity are tinted or coloured blue.
records.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，魔法物品的名稱將會顯示為藍色。

records.english: The primary resource for using skills, represented by the Blue orb on the UI.
records.zhTW: 使用技能的主要資源，在玩家介面上透過藍色球狀物表示。

records.english: Usually refers to the Map item type, which can be used in a Map Device to enter an area that is imbued with the mods that were present on the map when it was used. May also refer to the navigation tool on the UI.
records.zhTW: 一般指一種道具類型，能夠透過製圖裝置使用開啟帶有各種詞綴的地區。同使可能指遊戲中的地圖介面。

records.english: Any one of the NPCs which you encounter in the world and have special side missions for you to complete.
records.zhTW: 你在鬼島中遇到任何會給你特殊任務的 NPC。

records.english: Refers to the use of the crafting bench available in your Hideout.
records.zhTW: 意旨使用在藏身處的工藝台對物品進行修改的動作。

records.english: Any attack which is not ranged. Typically very close-range.
records.zhTW: 任何非遠程的攻擊。一般來說範圍很近。

records.english: A stationary object that can be placed and detonated by the player.
records.zhTW: 靜止的物件，玩家能夠放置並且引爆。

records.english: Usually refers to Mirror of Kalandra, the rarest currency item. A Mirrored item cannot be modified.
records.zhTW: 一般指「卡蘭德的魔鏡」，遊戲中最為稀有的通貨物品。被鏡像的物品將無法進一步修改。

records.english: Short for Modifier. Anything that modifies an item, area or skill is a mod.
records.zhTW: 任何能夠改變/修正物品、地區、技能、角色效果的屬性，皆稱為詞綴。

records.english: Short for Microtransaction. Usually refers to the cosmetic effects for sale in the shop.
records.zhTW: 能夠透過商城取得的外觀效果。

records.english: One of the rarity tiers. Normal items have no special qualities and appear white or uncoloured.
records.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，普通物品的名稱將會顯示為白色，並且沒有特殊效果。

records.english: Passive skills that are smaller than keystones but larger than most other passives. Notables usually provide strong benefits.
records.zhTW: 核心天賦點比一般的天賦點大，比關鍵天賦小，具有較特殊的名字且提供較多的能力。

records.english: Short for non-player character. Includes any character that can be talked to or traded with, but usually doesn't refer to enemies.
records.zhTW: 包含任何能夠互動的非玩家角色，一般不是敵人。

records.english: The small, sole-surviving city of the now defunct Sarn Empire. Each player character was exiled from Oriath.
records.zhTW: 薩恩帝國唯一殘存下的城市。每位流亡者都是從奧瑞亞流放出來的。

records.english: The powers obtained from major and minor gods are stored and selected on the Pantheon screen.
records.zhTW: 從主神和次神取得的神之力會顯示在眾神殿介面中。

records.english: Any group of two or more players that have joined forces. Players in a party all gain experience from slain monsters if they're close enough, and can chat to one another.
records.zhTW: 任兩位以上玩家一同冒險。組隊中的玩家皆可獲得擊殺怪物所獲得的經驗，他們也能夠在隊伍中聊天交流。

records.english: Anything you can assign a passive skill point to. Passive skills provide incremental benefits for the player character.
records.zhTW: 任何能夠使用天賦點數啟用的效果。天賦能夠使你的角色越來越強大。

records.english: The area surrounding Sarn, named for one of Sarn's early emperors.
records.zhTW: 薩恩城周邊地帶，以薩恩較早期的帝王命名。

records.english: One of the five damage types, along with Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Chaos. Physical damage has no special features by default.
records.zhTW: 和冰冷、火焰、混沌、閃電傷害一樣，為五種傷害屬性的其中之一。物理傷害沒有其他特殊的效果。

records.english: Created by using a Portal Scroll. Most portals take players to the nearest Town.
records.zhTW: 一般來說透過傳送卷軸生成。大多數的傳送們將玩家送達最近的城鎮。

records.english: One of the Affix categories. Prefixes are typically stronger than suffixes.
records.zhTW: 詞綴的類型。一般來說前綴相較下比後綴來的強大。

records.english: An attack or spell component which travels without being connected to the casting or attacking player.
records.zhTW: 法術或攻擊的一部分，包含任何在飛行中不和施法或攻擊者相連的物件。

records.english: Improves the effectiveness of weapon, equipment, skill gems, support gems, and other items. Quality is usually limited to 20%.
records.zhTW: 品質會增加武器、裝備、技能寶石、輔助寶石和其他物品的效果。一般來說品質的上限為20%。

records.english: A task which either forwards the story or rewards the player upon completion. Questgivers are indicated by a yellow '!' above their head.
records.zhTW: 任務，一般來說會推進故事進度，或者提供給玩家獎勵。當NPC頭上顯示黃色「！」表示該NPC有任務需要你的協助。

records.english: One of the rarity tiers. Rare items typically have up to six random mods. Rares are coloured or tinted yellow.
records.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一，稀有物品的名稱將會顯示為黃色，並且能擁有至多六條隨機詞綴。

records.english: The term used to describe how many mods an item can have, or how strong an enemy is. There are four rarity tiers: Normal, Magic, Rare and Unique.
records.zhTW: 一般指物品能擁有幾條詞綴，或者敵人多強大。物品稀有度階級一共分四個階級：普通、魔法、稀有、傳奇。

records.english: A keyword which is short for "within the last four seconds".
Used to calculate the amount of damage dealt or taken by sources of Fire, Cold, Lightning or Chaos damage.
records.zhTW: 用來計算受到或者造成的各種屬性傷害，包含火焰、冰冷、閃電、混沌。

records.english: An enemy, usually clad in Microtransactions, that attacks with skills commonly used by players. Rogue Exiles drop an item from each equipment slot.
records.zhTW: 敵人的一種，穿著華麗的商城物品，大多使用一般玩家會使用的技能。擊敗盜賊流亡者後他將掉落所有部位裝備各一件。

records.english: The capital city of the Eternal Empire, and the primary location for Act 3.
records.zhTW: 位於第三章的主要城鎮。不朽帝國的首都。

records.english: The source of most active skills. Skill gems, when socketed in weapons or armour, grant a skill. This skill can be augmented by linking the skill gem with a support gem.
records.zhTW: 主動技能的來源。當你將技能寶石插入武器或裝備的插槽時你將獲得該技能。此技能可以透過輔助寶石進一步增加效果。

records.english: A slot where a Skill or Support gem can be placed in weapons or armour. The passive tree also has sockets, however these sockets can only hold jewels.
records.zhTW: 位於武器或者裝備上的「洞」，能夠將技能寶石、輔助寶石插入。天賦樹中也存有插槽，但天賦樹中的插槽只能夠插入寶珠。

records.english: One of the main skill types. Any skill gem with the "spell" or "cast" tag is a spell. Spells are unaffected by anything that affects attacks, unless an item or skill specifically says otherwise. Spells can create things that attack (such as Raise Zombie) but do not themselves count as attacks.
records.zhTW: 主要技能類型之一。任何技能寶石標有「法術」標籤則為此類型技能。法術不受到任何攻擊的詞綴影響，除非該物品有特別說明。法術能夠創造出能夠攻擊的物件（像是殭屍復甦）但不代表該法術屬於攻擊技能。

records.english: The primary way to store items and pass them between characters is via the stash. The stash can be expanded by purchasing stash tabs in the microtransaction shop.
records.zhTW: 儲藏和同帳號角色之間物品交流的主要手段。前往商城能購買倉庫擴充頁。

records.english: One of the three attributes, along with Dexterity and Intelligence. Strength passively grants some life and melee physical damage.
records.zhTW: 和敏捷與智力一樣，為三項屬性的其中之一。力量能夠提升你的角色生命和近戰物理傷害。

records.english: A special kind of chest that can be modified with Currency. Almost all strongboxes are guarded by several packs of monsters, and cannot be opened until those monsters have been slain.
records.zhTW: 可使用通貨道具修改的箱子。幾乎所有的保險箱都受到怪物守護著，必須清光這些怪物保險箱才會順利開啟。

records.english: One of the two main affix groups. Suffixes tend to be weaker than prefixes. On Magic items and monsters, suffixes can be seen as the last part of the item's name (such as 'of Heat' or 'of Calm')
records.zhTW: 兩種主要詞綴的其中之一，相較前綴較為弱勢。

records.english: Used to modify the behaviour, cost, and power of skill gems. Support gems have no effect by themselves and must be linked to a skill gem to have any effect.
records.zhTW: 能夠使技能寶石的特性、消耗、強度產生變化。一般來說輔助寶石本身不帶有任何效果，必須與技能寶石連結才能夠顯現出它的價值。

records.english: Any player who purchases a Supporter Pack or other microtransaction from the shop. Supporters keep the Path of Exile developers fed and happy. We love supporters!
records.zhTW: 曾購買任何贊助包或者商城道具的玩家。贊助者是流亡黯道的製作團隊的衣食父母，也讓製作團隊開心，我們超愛贊助者的。

records.english: One of the past challenge leagues. Tempest is also the name of the signature effect of the Tempest challenge league. Tempests create fields around the world that influence player and monster behaviours, such as shrinking them or granting a speed boost.
records.zhTW: 過去其中一期挑戰聯盟的名稱。風暴會在區域中產生並對區域中的怪物和流亡者們造成諸多變異，例如改變體型大小、造成傷害、改變掉寶率、甚至使掉落的武器自動幻化。

records.english: A stationary object that can cast spells or attack remotely. Unlike traps and mines, totems have a life pool akin to minions. Unlike minions, totems can't typically move around, and are unaffected by minion modifiers.
records.zhTW: 無法行動的物件，能夠遠端施放法術或攻擊。和陷阱和地雷不同的是，圖騰有自己的生命值，並且不會受到怪物詞綴的影響。

records.english: Any location other than a Hideout where players can buy, sell, and stash items. Towns also contain quest-givers and other NPCs.
records.zhTW: 任何非藏身處但可以販售、購買、使用倉庫的區域。城鎮中也會存在NPC和任務。

records.english: The act of exchanging one good for another, typically between two players (rather than between a player and an NPC). There is a trade chat channel designed to allow players to advertise their items for sale.
records.zhTW: 意旨玩家與玩家間的物品交換。遊戲中設有交易頻道，讓玩家有專門的管道能夠與其他玩家交易。

records.english:
A stationary object that, when triggered, can attack or cast a spell. Traps break after they have been triggered, and can be easily destroyed by enemy attacks and spells, however they are also very difficult to see. 

May also refer to the traps in the Labyrinth which serve as damaging obstacles.
records.zhTW: 靜止難以察覺的物件，被觸發後能夠攻擊或者施放法術。陷阱在觸發或者被敵人攻擊/法術擊中後會遭到破壞。

records.english:
Typically refers to items or skill or support gems that cast a spell or deal an attack without the player's direct input. 'Cast on Critical Strike Support' is an example of a Trigger gem.

May also refer to the act of setting off a Trap.
records.zhTW: 一般意旨某些不需要玩家直接使用的技能或輔助寶石。（例如：「暴擊時施放」就是典型觸發類的輔助寶石）

records.english: One of the rarity tiers. Uniques do not have randomly generated names or mods, setting them apart from the other rarity tiers. Unique monsters are typically very strong, while unique items can provide a wide range of effects not available on other items.
records.zhTW: 物品稀有度的階級之一。和其他階級的物品不同，傳奇物件沒有隨機生成的名稱或詞綴。傳奇怪物一般來說非常強大，傳奇物品則會提供眾多其他其他道具上不會出現的特殊效果。

records.english: The oldest known culture on Wraeclast. The Vaal were the first known users of the gems, and their ruins are scattered across the land. Traces of the Vaal can be seen most notably in Act 2, and in the corrupted side areas. Vaal may also refer to the act of "Vaaling" an item -- using a Vaal orb on an item to corrupt it.
records.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯最古老的文明，是古靈寶石最早的使用者。他們的遺跡四散在各個地區，尤其在第二章節中更能夠找到瓦爾的蹤跡。瓦爾同時也代表使用瓦爾寶珠「瓦」某些物品使該物品受到汙染的動作。

records.english:
Typically refers to the act of selling an item at an NPC for scraps and fragments.

May also refer to the NPC themselves.
records.zhTW: 一般指將物品販賣給商人換取各種通貨碎片的動作。

records.english: A stacking effect that grants offensive attack bonuses for each stack. Stacks will be lost over time if you avoid combat for too long.
records.zhTW: 一種疊加效果，每疊加一層都會提供攻擊性加成。如果你長時間避戰，疊層將隨著時間的推移而丟失。

records.english: A subset of skills that are not attacks or spells, and thus are unaffected by things that ordinarily affect attacks and spells. The potency of any Warcry skill is affected by how many enemies are nearby when it is used.
records.zhTW: 不屬於攻擊也不是法術的一系列技能，也因此不受到一般會影響攻擊與法術的詞綴所影響。戰吼的效力主要基於使用時附近怪物的數量。

records.english: The primary way of saving your progress through the world of Path of Exile. Waypoints allow travel to any other waypoint that you have previously found.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道中主要紀錄進度的方式，傳送點使你能夠在已經開啟的傳送點之間互相傳送。

records.english: A type of item that can only be equipped in the main-hand and off-hand slots. Weapons are a major factor in the damage dealt by most attacks, and can also influence which skills you can or cannot use.
records.zhTW: 一系列只能夠裝備於武器欄位的物品，是大多攻擊造成傷害量的主要指標，同時不同類型的武器也決定你能否使用某些技能。

records.english: The largest continent in Path of Exile's known world. Criminals on Oriath are exiled to Wraeclast, a mysterious continent with a murky and bloody history. Most of Path of Exile's main storyline takes place on Wraeclast.
records.zhTW: 奧瑞亞的罪人將被流放到瓦爾克拉斯，流亡黯道世界中最大最神秘的大陸，擁有血腥神秘的歷史背景。流亡黯道中大部分劇情皆在瓦爾克拉斯上發生。

records.english: Stats and Mods II: What to Look Out For
records.zhTW: 數值和詞綴 II：到底該留意些甚麼

records.english: Character builds in Path of Exile are extremely varied, and which items and passives are important to a character is highly dependent on what that character is trying to achieve, but there are some things almost everyone should look out for.
records.zhTW: 在流亡黯道中角色玩法和流派極為多變，不同的道具和天賦的價值也因此依每個流派的需求而異。雖然如此，還是有某些屬性是幾乎每個角色都用的到的！

records.english: Because of the properties of Fireball, this staff increases Fireball's damage by 66%.
records.zhTW: 因為火球的特性，這把長杖將能夠增加火球的傷害整整 66%

records.english:
Unless you're in a coordinated group, every character needs a way to kill monsters. Figure out how you plan to deliver damage and look for items that amplify that. If you plan to shoot arrows at monsters from afar, a high-damage bow, as well as passive skills that benefit your chosen weapon, are a must. 

If you plan to cast spells, look for weapons with 'increased Spell Damage'. If you're strictly dealing fire damage, look for things that boost your fire damage. A fire spell like Fireball benefits from increases to fire, spell, and projectile damage. A character who wants to smash things with a one-handed mace should look for modifiers to one-handed weapons, maces, attacks and melee attacks specifically.
records.zhTW:
除非你時常和親朋好友組成特殊隊伍，否則幾乎每個角色都需要利用某種方式殺死怪物。找出造成傷害的方法，接著收集可以加強它的道具。如果你想遠遠的對敵人發射箭矢，一把攻擊力高的弓和加強弓系傷害的天賦幾乎可以說是必備的。

如果你想施放法術，那麼你可以嘗試尋找有「增加法術傷害」的武器。如果你對火屬性情有獨鍾，那麼你也可以把焦點擺在火屬性傷害加成的道具。舉例來說「火球」，它不僅可以被「增加火焰傷害」影響，也能夠受到「增加法術傷害」、「增加投射物傷害」的影響。一位想要使用單手錘打扁怪物的角色，可以把焦點擺在「單手武器傷害」、「單手錘傷害」、「攻擊傷害」、「近戰傷害」相關的詞綴。

records.english: Weapon-specific passives are often stronger than more generalised passives, but you lose some flexibility in which items you can use.
records.zhTW: 限定武器的天賦一般來說比廣泛影響的天賦來的強力，但同時你失去了武器選擇的彈性。

records.english:
You can't kill monsters if you're dead, so you should also carefully consider your defences. Most characters will want some armour, energy shield or evasion, or some combination of the three. Sources of life and increases to it are a great way to extend your lifespan, but you'll also want to seek out ways to mitigate the damage before it ever touches your life pool. 

Fire damage, such as the fire from a cannibal's thrown torch, can be mitigated by sources of 'Fire Resistance'. Merveil's spells deal cold damage, so 'Cold Resistance' is very useful against her. If a certain spell or attack deals significantly more damage to you than anything else, it might be of an element that you don't have much resistance to. If you're ever unsure where you spend your next passive point, it's almost always worth investing in a relevant defence.
records.zhTW:
不論你再怎麼厲害，死了一切都是浮雲。在提升角色能力的同時，你也可以多多研究你的防禦手段。大多角色選擇使用護甲、能量護盾、閃避、或者混搭。同時基礎生命和增加生命相關的來源也非常受歡迎，但最有效的方式就是在傷害還沒碰到你的生命池前就已經被減免緩和了。

火焰傷害，可以透過「火焰抗性」來減免。莫薇爾的法術造成冰冷傷害，所以「冰冷抗性」對付她非常有效。如果遊戲中突然發現某些技能對你的角色造成特別多傷害，可能是因為你對應的抗性過低。如果你不確定接下來的天賦該往何處發展，防禦手段幾乎都是不錯的選擇。

records.english: Not too shabby! As you progress, you'll be able to fill some gaps using the crafting benches given to you by characters called Masters.
records.zhTW: 還不賴！隨著角色的成長，你可以透過大師提供給你的工藝台來補足需求。

records.english: While out in the wilds of Wraeclast, you might've run out of bag space and found that you couldn't pick anything else up. Luckily, every Town and Hideout in Path of Exile comes with a stash. The items you put in your stash can be accessed wherever a stash can be found. You'll find the same items you stashed in Lioneye's Watch waiting for you at the Forest Encampment, your Hideout, and anywhere else with a stash.
records.zhTW: 在瓦爾克拉斯流亡的同時，你可能會發現包包時常滿到不能再拾取任何物品了。好在每個城鎮和藏身處都配置了一個私人倉庫。而且每個倉庫的空間都是互相流通的，你在獅眼守望放進倉庫的物品，在森林營地、你的藏身處、或者任何其他城鎮的倉庫中都能找到。

records.english: Every Town and Hideout has a stash.
records.zhTW: 每個城鎮和藏身處皆有倉庫。

records.english: In fact, all your other characters in the same league can also access the same stash, so if you get a great bow while playing your Marauder, you can stash it to use on your Ranger later.
records.zhTW: 帳號中隸屬相同聯盟下的角色皆使用相同的倉庫空間，當你使用野蠻人冒險時找到了一把不錯的弓，你可以透過倉庫轉移給你的遊俠使用。

records.english: At some point you may find yourself running low on stash space. Extra stash tabs can be bought in the Microtransactions shop, and once purchased, will be available in every league. They come in a few different varieties:
records.zhTW: 流亡一段時間後你可能會覺得自己的倉庫空間漸漸無法滿足需求。不必擔心，額外的倉庫頁可以透過商城購買，而且一旦購買日後每一個聯盟都可以使用。倉庫頁分幾種類別：

records.english: Basic stash tabs are functionally identical to your free tabs.
records.zhTW: 一般倉庫頁和起初免費的倉庫頁擁有一樣的功能。

records.english: Premium stash tabs can be labelled and colour-coded for ease of use, and allow you to list items for sale. You can price each item individually or set a price that applies for every item in the tab.
records.zhTW: 高級倉庫頁提供了命名和更改標籤顏色的功能，也使你可以設置販售該頁面中的道具。你可以單獨為想販售的道具標價，或者將整個倉庫頁設為均一價。

records.english: The specialised stash tabs, such as the Currency stash tab, can hold thousands of specific items, far exceeding the normal stack-size limits, and keep them neatly organized.
records.zhTW: 特殊倉庫頁，如通貨倉庫頁，能夠儲藏上千個特定物品，完全高出平常的堆疊限制，而且還擺的整整齊齊。

records.english:
All stash tabs have a search bar at the bottom that lets you search for and and filter out items, so you can quickly find what you are looking for.

The items in your stash never go away. However, when a temporary league ends, all the items in your stash will be moved to the stash in its permanent equivalent.

When this happens, your items can be found in stash tabs labelled "Remove Only". These will hold your items indefinitely, but anything removed from a Remove Only tab can't be returned to that tab.
records.zhTW:
每一種倉庫頁的下方都提供了搜尋的功能，讓你可以迅速方便的找到自己的物品。

倉庫中的物品永遠不會消失。然而當挑戰聯盟或者短期聯盟結束後，它們將會被移動至對應的長期聯盟中。

這類轉移發生後，你的道具將會出現在長期聯盟的倉庫中，分頁名稱將顯示為「只能取出」，這些倉庫頁雖然沒有保存期限，但如其名稱所指出，物品取出後是無法放回去的。「只能取出」倉庫頁被清空後，重新登入遊戲後將會消失。

records.english: Remove-only tabs keep your items safe and sound after a challenge league ends.
records.zhTW: 「只能取出」倉庫頁會完善保存你的物品。

records.english: Wraeclast is pretty big, and is full of places you'll want to visit and revisit. To help you get around, the land is dotted with 'Waypoints' which let you quickly travel to destinations you have previously visited. To use a waypoint, activate it and select where you would like to travel. You can only travel to waypoints you've activated previously, so it is always worth activating new waypoints when you come across them.
records.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯是個非常大的陸地，也有很多地方是時常需要拜訪的。為了讓流亡者更容易跑腿，地圖上會出現許多傳送點，讓你在啟用後能夠迅速的往返。

records.english: Selecting a quest icon on the World Panel will display a path to the next step of the quest.
records.zhTW: 選擇任務圖示後，世界面板將會顯示下一步的路線。

records.english:
When you click on a waypoint, the panel that pops up is called the World Panel. It doesn't just show your waypoints, however; It also displays every area you have previously visited, as well as some connected areas you haven't been to yet. Your quests are listed below the map, and by selecting one you can highlight the path that you need to follow to complete it. 

Because areas in Path of Exile have varying degrees of random generation, you may not always recognize the layout of an area, even if you've been there several times. The minimap or map overlay may also be different and will need to be revealed again. This may take some getting used to, but it means no two playthroughs are exactly the same.
records.zhTW:
點擊傳送點後，世界面板將會彈出。它將會顯示出所有你已經拜訪過的地區，同時也會顯示出相連的為探索區域。你的任務會顯示在地圖的下方，選擇任務圖示後，世界面板將會顯示下一步的路線。

在流亡黯道的世界中，每次進入一個區域，該地圖都有隨機生成的機制，所以就算你已經拜訪過某些區域數次，你可能還是沒辦法一眼確定地形。這也代表每次遊戲都有比較不一樣的體驗。

records.english: Monsters throughout Wraeclast won't just hurt you -- they can also inflict [Ailments]. Fortunately, you can too.
records.zhTW: 瓦爾克拉斯各地的怪物不只會對你造成傷害，它們還會施加[Ailments|異常狀態]。幸運的是，你也可以這麼做。

records.english: [Ailments] usually come from a specific kind of damage. [Fire] damage can '[Ignite]', which deals further fire damage over time. [Cold] damage can '[Chill]', slowing you down, or '[Freeze]', causing you to stop moving entirely. [Lightning] damage can '[Shock]', causing you to take a lot of extra damage from any source. Some enemies can also '[Poison]' you or inflict '[Bleeding]', both of which deal damage over time. If you move while you're bleeding it will deal extra damage.
records.zhTW: [Ailments|異常狀態]通常會由特定類型的傷害所造成。[Fire|火焰]傷害可以「[Ignite|點燃]」，進一步造成火焰持續傷害。[Cold|冰冷]傷害可以「[Chill|冰緩]」，使你的速度減慢，或是「[Freeze|冰凍]」，使你完全無法移動。[Lightning|閃電]傷害可以「[Shock|感電]」，使任何來源都會對你造成大量額外傷害。部分敵人還能使你「[Poison|中毒]」或施加「[Bleeding|流血]」，兩者皆會造成持續傷害。若你在流血時移動，則會造成額外傷害。

records.english: Each ailment typically comes from a specific type of damage, though some unique items can change this.
records.zhTW: 異常狀態一般來自特定的傷害，但某些傳奇物品可以改變規則。

records.english: Items, passive skills, support and skill gems, curses, and other things can each influence how likely it is that you'll suffer or inflict any of these [Ailments], as well as how effective these ailments are.
records.zhTW: 物品、天賦、輔助和技能寶石、詛咒和其他要素，都會影響你承受或造成這些[Ailments|異常狀態]的機率，以及這些異常狀態的效力。

records.english: Unique items and passive skills can prevent you from suffering from specific [Ailments], or grant something beneficial when you're suffering from one.
records.zhTW: 傳奇物品和天賦可以防止你被施加特定的[Ailments|異常狀態]，或是當你正在承受異常狀態時，賦予某種增益效果。

records.english: Flasks are capable of removing each [Ailments|ailment] if they have the right mods. Figuring out which ailments might be dangerous to you and getting flasks that will remove them can make a big difference to your journey.
records.zhTW: 若具備正確的詞綴，藥劑便能將每種[Ailments|異常狀態]移除。考慮哪一種異常狀態可能會對你造成危險，並使用能將其移除的藥水，如此一來你的旅程將變得更加輕鬆。

records.english: Path of Exile is an online game where you can talk, trade, and play with other players whenever you want.
records.zhTW: 在流亡黯道中你將能夠與其它玩家一起遊玩、聊天、交易。

records.english: There are several chat channels enabled by default, which can be toggled on and off using the buttons at the top of the chat window. You can also select which channel you want to talk in via the drop-down menu at the bottom.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道的聊天室預設就已經為你開啟了多個聊天頻道，你可以透過聊天室上方的按鈕將它們關閉。聊天時你可以透過左下角的下拉式選單選擇你要發言的頻道。

records.english: You can link items in chat with Ctrl + Alt + Left-click
records.zhTW: 按下 Ctrl + Alt後左鍵點擊物品將可以把該物品資訊發送至聊天視窗。

records.english: The Social panel (Hotkey S) is where you can quickly access your friends list, guild and party. Once you add a friend, both their account name and character name will be visible to you. If they have a Hideout and have enabled their friends to enter it, you'll be able to enter their Hideout from this menu while in your own Hideout or a Town.
records.zhTW: 透過社交面板（快捷建：S）你可以迅速的瀏覽你的好友、公會、隊伍資訊。成功登錄好友後，你將能夠看到對方的帳號名稱和角色名稱。如果你的朋友擁有自己的藏身處並且開放他人參觀，你將能夠透過此介面前往參觀。

records.english: You can also use this panel to join public parties created by other players, or create your own.
records.zhTW: 你也可以使用此面板建立自己的公開隊伍或加入其他玩家的公開隊伍。

records.english: If you're looking to buy, sell, or exchange items with another player, you can open the trade window by right-clicking a character in the world. If they're in your party, you can trade by right-clicking their character portrait. Items up for trade must be checked by each player before the trade can be completed, to ensure you know exactly what it is you're trading for.
records.zhTW: 若希望與其他玩家進行買賣或者是交換物品，你可以使用右鍵點擊其他玩家並選擇交易的選項。如果對方與你處同一個隊伍之中，點擊對方的角色頭像也能夠開啟交易視窗。每次的交易中雙方玩家都必須使用鼠標確認交易的物品，否則將無法完成該交易，提醒流亡者們務必留意交易的內容。

records.english: Path of Exile's players come from all walks of life, and the Path of Exile community is an important part of what makes Path of Exile so much fun. So please remember to be respectful when you talk to other players.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道中的玩家來自各地，也都是使流亡黯道社群熱絡的重要一員。在與其他玩家互動時也希望大家能表現出最基本的禮儀，尊重、包容、友善。

records.english:
Prophecies are similar to the quests that characters like Tarkleigh send you on, however they are less structured, less predictable, and can only be acquired from Navali in exchange for a silver coin. 

Prophecies can do a broad range of things. Some can guarantee that certain items will drop from specific monsters. Some add new monsters to areas, some drastically change the look of certain areas, and some grant avenues to new or upgraded unique items.
records.zhTW:
和一般的任務相似，但更難以捉模，沒有一定的模式，只能透過娜瓦莉花費銀幣隨機取得。

預言能提供非常廣泛的效果。有些能夠保證特定的物品從特定的怪物掉落。有些會為地圖增加更多怪物，有些甚至會改變地區的樣貌，有些還能夠將傳奇物品升級成更強大的版本。

records.english: Sometimes you may get a prophecy that you don't want or need at that moment. Navali can seal such prophecies for some silver coins, turning it into an item that you can store in your stash or trade to another player.
records.zhTW: 偶爾你可能會取得對你目前沒有用處的預言，這時你可以花費銀幣請娜瓦莉協助將它封印。封印後的預言會轉化成一件可以儲藏、交易的物品道具。

records.english: While some prophecies can grant you access to powerful and valuable rewards, sometimes the prophecy IS the reward. Remember, you can end up fulfilling a prophecy without meaning to, so it's always worth considering spending some silver to save a nice crafting prophecy for an item that could greatly benefit from it.
records.zhTW: 有些預言會引領你取得極有價值的獎勵，但別忘了有些預言本身的效果就是價值的所在。為了不要不經意的浪費掉某些稀有的預言，有時將它們封印起來是非常明智的選擇。

records.english:
You can modify a vast number of objects in Path of Exile using the various orbs, scrolls, essences, whetstones and other stacking consumables. Collectively these items are referred to as "Currency", as they are also used to trade and barter with both NPCs and other players. At higher levels you might find currencies that other players value highly.
 
The Orb of Transmutation, Orb of Alteration and Orb of Augmentation are great items to carry and use during your journey. They can be used to upgrade normal items to magic and to reroll or change the mods on magic items, and they're common enough that you can pretty quickly replace whatever you use. Using these currencies on flasks can let you customize their behaviour.
records.zhTW:
在流亡黯道中你能夠使用多種道具對物品進行改造，像是點金石、精髓、磨刀石、卷軸等消耗型道具，一般稱之為\「通貨\」，因為它們時常被當作交易貨幣的一種，隨著你的等級提升，你也將能夠找到更有價值的通貨。

改造石、蛻變石、增幅石都是非常常見也是平常帶在身上極為有用的通貨物品。它們能夠將普通物品升級成魔法物品，或者改變魔法物品的詞綴和屬性。使用在藥水上也能為你帶來更多不同的效果。

records.english:
If you're in need of a damage boost, try using them on a weapon base-type that is close to your level. Sometimes a magic item with the right mods is better than a rare item with the wrong ones.

We've listed out some of the more common currencies, and what they do, just below:
records.zhTW:
若你需要更多傷害，不妨試試將他們用在與你等級相近的武器上，有正確詞綴的魔法武器有時比起錯誤詞綴得稀有武器來的好用。

以下為更多常見的通貨物品和它們的用途：

records.english:
There are many more currency items than just these, and they can be used in other ways. Later on, you will be able to fill your Hideout with devices which let you spend currency to modify your items very precisely.
			 
If you've accumulated a few of a type of currency, don't be afraid to try using it on an item. Sometimes the results will surprise you!
records.zhTW:
除了上述的通貨以外，流亡黯道中還存在更多通貨與他們讓人意想不到的用途。隨著你的進度推進你也將會獲得藏身處工藝台，讓你消耗通貨更的同時更加準確的改造你的物品。

如果你已經取得了很多通貨，並且有多餘的武器道具，不妨嘗試使用它們，有時它們的結果會帶來驚喜。

records.english: Even strongboxes can be modified with currency. Keeping some with you will give you a degree of control over the contents of the strongboxes you come across.
records.zhTW: 即使是保險箱也能夠受到通貨的影響。身上隨時攜帶通貨能夠讓你遇到保險箱時多少控制保險箱的內容物。

records.english: There are many little tips and tricks that you will naturally pick up as you play Path of Exile, but here's a few that will make life in Wraeclast easier.
records.zhTW: 在流亡的旅途中你將自然而然的學習到許多有幫助的訣竅，在那之前以下提供幾個對你接下來在瓦爾克拉斯的時間可能有所幫助的建議。

records.english: While your stash or a vendor window is open, you can hold down 'Ctrl' and click items to quickly move them into or out of your inventory.
records.zhTW: 倉庫或者商人視窗打開的時候，按住 Ctrl 並左鍵點擊想要移動的道具可以省略拖曳的動作。

records.english: If you run out of room in your stash, you can buy more stash tabs in our in-game microtransaction shop. The same is true if you run out of character slots.
records.zhTW: 如果你的倉庫頁或者角色欄位放不下了，遊戲中的商城頁面提供多種倉庫頁和角色欄位讓流亡者們購買。

records.english: Holding Alt while hovering over an item in your inventory will display it against what you have equipped. It will also show any extra information if the item uses some complex or obscure game terms.
records.zhTW: 按住 Alt 鍵的同時，將鼠標移至物品上方將可以和目前角色裝備中的物品做比較，也可以看到該物品的詳細資訊。

records.english: At high levels you may find that item drops fill up your screen. In the UI tab of the Options menu you'll find an option to turn on an item filter. Item filters will limit which items are displayed and when.
records.zhTW: 隨著畫面上的掉落物變多，你可能會開始覺得地圖過於雜亂。在介面設定中你可以設置物品篩選器，將能夠訂製物品顯示的規則。

records.english: If you pick up a cool unique item or see a skill gem you want to use but it doesn't suit your build, stick it in your stash! Remember, your stash is shared across all of your characters in that league. Don't be afraid to make a new character and try out a new build. Building new characters is a big part of what makes Path of Exile so much fun.
records.zhTW: 撿到很酷的傳奇物品，還是突然找到了某顆想要使用的技能寶石了嗎？想使用卻與你目前的流派不搭？不用擔心，將它們收藏到你的倉庫中吧，別忘了你的倉庫與其他相同聯盟下的角色是共享的。不要害怕嘗試更多的職業、更多的角色和流派，流亡黯道會受歡迎的原因不就是因為流派的多樣性嗎？

records.english: Currency that enhances an item's quality works more effectively on Magic and Normal items. If you want to craft an item or need an item with a certain amount of quality, try enhancing the item before you upgrade its rarity.
records.zhTW: 提升道具品質類的通貨，當使用在魔法或一般稀有度的物品上時效益最高。在製作某些物品前建議可以先使用品質類通貨後再提升物品的稀有度。

records.english: Some item mods, such as "Squire's" on weapons and "Beetle's" on armour-based body armours, can give the appearance of actually being two mods. These are hybrid mods, and are actually single mods that grant two stats at lower values. That means you may still be able to craft an extra mod onto that item! If you're unsure if you have room on an item or not, try putting it in a Master's crafting bench.
records.zhTW: 某些出現在武器或者胸甲上的詞綴，乍看之下是兩條詞綴，實際上它可能是複合式詞綴，由兩條較低數值的效果組成。若不確定是否為複合式詞綴，建議你可以將該物品放進

records.english: If you ever get stuck, don't be afraid to ask for help. If players in the global chat can't answer your questions, you can always visit our forums.
records.zhTW: 如果不幸的卡關了，不要害怕，問就對了！如果世界頻道的玩家沒辦法回答你的問題你也可以試試官方論壇、各大論壇或者客服中心喔！

records.english: Your stash has a field at the bottom that lets you filter out items.
records.zhTW: 你的倉庫頁底部設有搜尋功能讓你能更輕易的找到你的道具。

records.english: Auras are skills that persistently affect things around you. Most auras, such as 'Hatred', affect you and your nearby allies and party members. They usually grant some sort of benefit, but reserve a portion of your mana for as long as you keep them activated.
records.zhTW: 光環是一系列對你的角色有持續效果的技能。大部分的光環，如「憎恨」會影響你與你的隊友。一般來說它們帶給你某種增益效果，但同時在它們啟用時會保留你魔力的一部分。

records.english: Some auras instead affect your nearby enemies. The 'Blasphemy Support' turns any supported curse into an aura that reserves some mana and curses any enemy that enters its radius.
records.zhTW: 有些光環僅會影響你周遭的敵人。「詛咒光環輔助」寶石會將它輔助的詛咒的效果轉換成光環，並和一般光環一樣保留你的魔力，同時影響附近的敵人。

records.english:
Reserved mana can't be used or recovered until whatever is reserving it is disabled, so consider whether you will be able to use your skills with the mana you have remaining. Things that change how skills interact with your mana (like 'Blood Magic') also apply to mana reservation.
 
Heralds also reserve mana and grant benefits that are similar to some of the aura skills, however they only affect you. Heralds also have special behaviours that interact with ailments.

Some auras don't reserve mana or don't persist indefinitely. This is true of Vaal versions of auras such as Vaal Grace.

Vaal auras have a limited duration but grant very powerful bonuses for the short time they are active.
records.zhTW:
被保留的魔力不能被使用也無法回復，直至對應的光環被停用。因此在啟動光環時必須留意剩餘的魔力是否足夠讓你可以靈活的使用你的技能。

捷光環，和一般光環較為不同的是，它只影響你自己。各個捷光環對於異常狀態都有對應的效果。

某些光環不保留魔力也不會永久維持效果。瓦爾版本的光環就是如此，像是瓦爾．優雅。

瓦爾光環雖然提供強大的增益效果，但持續時間非常的短暫。

records.english: Each Herald skill interacts in some way with its associated ailment.
records.zhTW: 各個捷光環對於異常狀態都有對應的效果。

records.english:
Jewels are items that have mods just like your weapons and armour. However, instead of being equipped, they are socketed in the passive skill tree.

Jewels only work when they're socketed in a jewel socket that has been allocated with a passive point. If they are in an unallocated socket, the jewel won't do anything.
records.zhTW: 珠寶和你的武器和裝備一樣擁有詞綴。然而它們無法直接裝備，必須透過天賦樹上的插槽才能夠獲得珠寶的效果。

records.english:
Just like other items, jewels can be normal, magic, rare or unique. They can be modified with currencies like other items, though unlike your weapons and armour, a rare jewel can only have up to four mods. 

Cluster jewels are a type of jewel that can only be socketed in the outer rim of your passive tree. These come in 3 sizes, small, medium and large, and allow you to expand your passive tree with new passive nodes, notables and even more jewel sockets!

Some unique jewels, such as Efficient Training above, can modify the passive skills around them:
records.zhTW:
就像其他物品一樣，珠寶也有分魔法、稀有、傳奇稀有度。珠寶也能夠受到通貨物品的改造，但不像一般的武器和裝備，珠寶最多只能擁有 4 條詞綴。

星團珠寶也是珠寶的一種，只能放置於你天賦樹外圍的插槽。星團珠寶有 3 個大小：小、中、大，並且可以讓你擴張你的天賦樹，有額外的天賦點、核心天賦和更多珠寶插槽！

部分傳奇珠寶，像是充分訓練，可以調整他們附近的天賦：

records.english: Some unique jewels have a radius and change the behaviour of passive skills within that radius.
records.zhTW: 某些傳奇珠寶甚至會改變它周遭的天賦的效果。

records.english:
The colour of a jewel affects the likelihood of it having certain mods, but has no effect on your ability to socket it.

Since the number of jewels you can socket is only limited by the number of jewel sockets you've allocated, some unique jewels have limits placed on them. If you have more of that type of jewel than the limit allows, the extra jewels won't have any effect.
records.zhTW:
珠寶的顏色意味著不同詞綴能在該珠寶上出現的機率，任何顏色的珠寶都能被插入置任何珠寶插槽中。

某些珠寶帶有同一時間能作用的數量限制，若你的角色天賦插入該珠寶的數量超出珠寶上所標示的數量限制，額外的珠寶將不會有任何效果。

records.english:
Throughout your journeys you will encounter other exiles. The Forsaken Masters are a set of such exiles who, when found, will offer you a quest for the area you're in. Each Master has a different style of quest, and within those quests there are many randomised features, so although you might have a general idea of what your task may be, the specifics may vary greatly. Be prepared!

If you succeed in helping one of these Masters, they will gain experience and eventually level up. Whenever a master levels up, you unlock something within their realm of expertise.
records.zhTW:
在流亡的旅途中你會遭遇其他流亡者。其中「被遺忘的大師」當你遇到他們時，會提供給你當前區域的任務。每位大師的任務模式都不太一樣，而且包含些許隨機的因素在。

若你成功完成大師們的任務，他們會獲得經驗值，完成夠多的任務就能夠使大師們提升等級。每當大師升級，他們也會將自己的專業領域透過其他的方式分享給你。

records.english: When a Master reaches level 3, they can grant you the ability to create a Hideout -- a place all to yourself that you can decorate as you see fit. If you have a Hideout, a Master of level 2 or higher can also give you their crafting bench.
records.zhTW: 當大師等級達到 3 等時，他們將給予你能夠建立自己藏身處的功能。一個屬於你自己的地盤，一個隨心所欲的佈置的空間。當你已經擁有一個藏身處後，當大師達到等級 2 他們將會提供給你特別的工藝桌。

records.english: Each Master's crafting bench offers different crafting options. Elreon's Blessing Font primarily works with rings and amulets, for example, while Vagan's Sharpening Wheel improves melee weapons. As you level up the associated Master, their crafting bench options grow.
records.zhTW: 每位大師的工藝桌都不同，提供的工藝選項也有所區別。舉例來說博學大師的工藝桌主要提供戒指、項鍊相關的詞綴，而武器大師的工藝桌則較專注於近戰武器詞綴。隨著大師的等級提升工藝桌的選項也會增加。

records.english: Masters also buy and sell items. At high levels, some of the items they offer can't be found anywhere else. They will also sell Hideout decorations in exchange for favour, which is earned as you help them. Their range of decorations for sale also grows as they level up.
records.zhTW: 大師也會買賣物品，大師所賣的物品有些在別處是找不到的。大師也會販賣藏身處裝飾品，但購買裝飾品必須消耗友好度，透過平常協助他們解任務來取得的點數。隨著大師的等級提升，販售的裝飾品也會越多。

records.english:
Masters in your Hideout can also offer you a daily mission. Daily missions take the same structure as their ordinary missions but offer significantly more Master experience and favour. Whenever you complete a Master's daily mission their inventory of wares for sale changes.

Be sure to check your Hideout daily if you want to rapidly level up your Masters!
records.zhTW:
每位被邀請至藏身處的大師每天會提供給你一項任務。這些每日任務和平時的大師任務模式相似，但能夠獲得比平時更多的大師友好值。每當你完成大師的每日任務，該大師所販售的物品將刷新。

若想要迅速的升級你的大師，記得每天都拜訪一下藏身處的大師！

records.english:
You may have noticed that sometimes when you sell some items to an NPC you get something unexpected. You may have encountered a 'vendor recipe'!

Items with certain properties, or specific combinations of items, can be sold together to fulfil a recipe. Listed below are a few useful examples:
records.zhTW:
你可能發現，當你將某些物品販售給NPC時偶爾會出現意想不到的物品，流亡黯道中稱之為「交易配方」。

物品上不同的屬性或者擁有某些特性的物品同時販售給NPC後會達成特定條件，能夠取得對應的道具，以下為常較為用的範例：

records.english:
There are many more than these, some of which are complex and result in powerful unique items or valuable currency. 

Try experimenting with different combinations of items. You might just stumble upon a new recipe.
records.zhTW: 除了上述配方外，還有更多更複雜的配方，有些說不定會給予你強大的傳奇物品或價值連城的通貨。

records.english:
The Labyrinth is a dungeon unlike any other in Path of Exile. It is filled with perilous traps, valuable secrets, tricky puzzles, and objectives that may require you to do things across several areas. 
			
To gain access to the Labyrinth, you must complete the six prerequisite trials that are scattered across the first three acts. A portal to the Aspirants' Plaza will then appear in the centre of the Sarn Encampment, and it is in the Aspirants' Plaza that all versions of the Labyrinth can be reached.
records.zhTW:
帝王迷宮與流亡黯道中其他地牢不同。帝王迷宮中充斥著陷阱、秘密、謎題、甚至會需要你在多個區域完成目標。

若想進入帝王迷宮，首先你必須完成前個章節中出現的六種試煉，即可前往薩恩城進入試練者廣場。

records.english: Best each of the six trials and you can enter the Aspirants' Plaza via the Sarn Encampment.
records.zhTW: 完成全六種試煉，即可前往薩恩城進入試練者廣場。

records.english:
Successfully navigating the Labyrinth ultimately leads to a sequence of fights with the Labyrinth's creator, Izaro. Failure to survive the Labyrinth means starting again, so be careful where you step.
 
If you manage to make it to the end, you'll be rewarded with treasure, an opportunity to enhance an item, and the ability to select your Ascendancy class.
records.zhTW:
在帝王迷宮中順利前進，你將會遇上帝王迷宮的創造者，伊澤洛。在迷宮中死亡代表著從頭開始，流亡者必須全神貫注，步步為營。

成功到達迷宮的終點，你將會獲得寶藏、附魔道具的機會、和昇華職業的選擇。

records.english: The Labyrinth's structure changes every day, but you can view the sequence of chambers as you progress through them, as well as what features they may hold.
records.zhTW: 迷宮的構造每天都會改變，但隨著探索，你將能看到每個區域的順序和內容。

records.english:
There are four versions of the Labyrinth, each with a different set of entry requirements, and each reward you with two Ascendancy points upon completing it for the first time. 

Unlike most areas in Path of Exile, the Labyrinth's structure does not change greatly between runs during the same day, but once a day the layout is randomised.
records.zhTW:
帝王迷宮目前有四種版本，各個版本都有各自進入的條件，第一次完成後也各會獎勵你兩點昇華點數。

不像流亡黯道中其他的地區，帝王迷宮除了每天隨機重置以外當天的迷宮不論進入幾次都不會有太大的改變。

records.english:
Although any class in Path of Exile can eventually reach any passive skill on the passive skill tree, each class has their own distinct set of Ascendancy classes. A Witch can, for example, eventually become an Elementalist, but a Templar cannot. 
 
You can unlock your Ascendancy class by completing the Labyrinth and using the Altar of Ascendancy in the final room. Higher-tier Labyrinths then grant two more Ascendancy points when you reach the Altar of Ascendancy, for a total of 8 points.
records.zhTW:
雖然流亡黯道中任何職業都可以隨心所欲的擴展天賦，但每個職業都擁有屬於自己的昇華職業。舉例來說，女巫將能夠昇華成為「元素使」但聖騎士卻不行。

在第一次完成帝王迷宮後點擊昇華盤即可選擇解鎖昇華職業，後續更高階的帝王迷宮中，每次完成都會獎勵你額外 2 點昇華點數，每隻角色最多可以取得 8 點昇華點數。

一般、專家
和自力模式

records.english:
The two primary modes for playing Path of Exile are Standard and Hardcore. In Standard, if your character dies, you respawn at a nearby checkpoint and have the opportunity to try again. At higher levels you will start to lose a portion of your experience when you die. Don't worry, you can't go down in level from dying too much.
 
In Hardcore, however, one death means you're out. Characters that die in Hardcore are sent to Standard, along with any items they were carrying. To reach a high level in Hardcore is a big achievement -- one that even very experienced players struggle with.
records.zhTW:
流亡黯道中最主要的兩種遊戲方式為「一般」或「專家」模式。在一般模式中若你的角色死亡你將會重生在最近的城鎮或者重生點，後期當你的角色死亡你將會失去一部份經驗值。但也別擔心，即使你的角色已經沒有經驗值，死亡也不會使你降低等級。

在專家模式中，每個角色只有一次機會。專家模式死亡的角色和身上的物品將會被轉移至一般模式。在專家模式達到高等是非常優秀的成就，即便是老手也必須努力奮鬥一番。

records.english:
Both of these modes also have a Solo Self-Found (SSF) variant. In these SSF leagues players cannot team up or trade with any other players. That means the only items they have access to are the ones they've found or made. Players in SSF leagues can opt-out at any time and join the community of players in Standard (if they were playing Standard SSF), or Hardcore (if they were playing Hardcore SSF). 
 
There is no tangible benefit to playing Hardcore or SSF -- only the prestige. So if the idea of not being able to play with others or being booted out of your league if you die doesn't appeal, don't worry. It's the same game no matter how you choose to play.
records.zhTW:
每個聯盟都包含「自力」版本，在自力模式中玩家將無法組隊和交易。一切裝備、道具都必須靠自己的角色努力而來。自力角色隨時都可以選擇退出自力模式，退出後將會加入同聯盟下其他的玩家。

選擇遊玩專家或自力模式沒有額外的獎勵，只有對自己的挑戰和榮譽感。所以若對於這類遊戲模式沒有興趣，別擔心，不論甚麼模式下流亡黯道的遊戲內容都是一致的，想怎麼遊戲自己決定最重要。

records.english: Path of Exile launches new temporary challenge leagues several times a year. These temporary leagues always have some twist or new gameplay mechanic that changes how you play, and a fresh economy. Everyone starts with nothing in their stash or on their character, other than a few flasks and scrolls. These leagues usually last about three months.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道每年都會推出多個短期的「挑戰聯盟」。這些短期聯盟都將包含不同的遊戲機制或新奇的規則，同時也提供所有流亡者一個全新的經濟，平等的起點。這些短期聯盟一般會持續三個月。

records.english: Many favourite Path of Exile features started out as challenge league mechanics: strongboxes, essences, breaches and tormented spirits, just to name a few.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道中目前的許多遊戲機制幾乎都來自過來的許多短期聯盟；像是保險箱、精髓、裂痕、罪魂等等。

records.english:
Challenge leagues also come with a set of special challenges (hence the name!). If you complete enough, you can earn exclusive microtransactions and Hideout decorations that are only available from that league.

When a challenge league ends, all of the items, characters, Atlas progress, and virtually anything else you can think of, transfer to their parent leagues, the permanent Standard and Hardcore leagues. Once everything has transferred across to Standard or Hardcore, you can continue playing those characters where you left off.

The start date of a new challenge league is usually announced several weeks in advance, and the first day of a new league is always very exciting, and bustling with players. The great majority of Path of Exile players play in these temporary challenge leagues. If you've never had a chance to experience it, we recommend joining us for the next one!
records.zhTW:
挑戰聯盟，如其名，帶來一系列挑戰。完成夠多挑戰，你將能獲得該聯盟獨家的商城道具和藏身處裝飾品。

當短期挑戰聯盟結束時，所有的道具、角色、輿圖進度、大師等級、和所有你能想到的皆會轉移合併至對應的聯盟。轉移完成後你還是可以繼續遊玩這些角色。

每個挑戰聯盟的開始時間都會在開始前幾周宣布，而每個新聯盟都會有最多的流亡者加入。大多流亡者選擇在挑戰聯盟中進行遊戲，如果你還沒體驗過，我們邀請你加入我們下一個短期聯盟！

records.english: Complete enough challenges within a league and you can earn an exclusive Hideout decoration.
records.zhTW: 完成足夠的聯盟挑戰，你將能獲得獨家的藏身處裝飾品。

records.english:
Divination cards are items found throughout Path of Exile that can be turned in for a reward. Different divination cards reward you with different things, including currency, specific item basetypes, other divination cards, and even unique items that can't normally be found. There are even some items that can only be obtained by collecting the right cards.
 
Every divination card was designed with the help of our supporters, though the rarity and drop locations were determined by Path of Exile developers.

Some divination cards can only be found in certain locations or from certain enemies, so pay attention to where you are when you find them. If there's one you really like, you might consider visiting that area frequently to find more.
records.zhTW:
你將能夠在瓦爾克拉斯各地找到命運卡，不同命運卡給予不同的獎勵，從通貨、特定基底物品、更多的命運卡、甚至是平常無法取得的傳奇道具。

某些命運卡只會在特定的地圖或者特定的怪物身上掉落，多多留意它們的來源，若有中意的命運卡，不妨時常去該區域打轉。

records.english: The number of cards you need to turn in for the reward is visible on the card itself. If you have a full stack of cards in your inventory or stash, the value on the icon will be blue instead of the usual white. Once you have enough, Tasuni in Highgate or Lilly Roth in your Hideout will accept them and reward you with the prize on the card.
records.zhTW: 命運卡上會顯示需要收集的數量。當你收集到該數量，數字會轉變呈現藍色。統治者之殿的達蘇尼和你藏身處的莉莉會非常樂意接受你的卡片並提供給你對應的獎勵。

records.english: Path of Exile is completely free to play. You can't buy items, experience boosts, or anything that provides power, and you can do every bit of content without ever spending a cent. That said, we greatly appreciate our supporters as they allow us to continue to develop the game we love.
records.zhTW: 流亡黯道是一款完全免費的遊戲。不花一毛錢也可以完整體驗流亡黯道的所有內容。我們也非常感激所有願意支持流亡黯道的贊助者，這使我們能夠繼續開發我們所愛的遊戲。

records.english:
To that end, cosmetic items and stash tabs can be purchased from the Microtransaction shop. If you run out of stash space, the store sells extra stash tabs (you can even buy them in bulk!). If you would like to organise your stash to a greater degree, premium stash tabs and specialised stash tabs such as the Currency tab are available for purchase.

There's also a wide variety of cosmetic items available for purchase. Some replace the appearance of an item, while some add to the appearance of the items you're already wearing. Some even completely change the way a particular skill looks. After you buy a cosmetic microtransaction, you can proudly display it by opening your inventory panel and navigating to the Cosmetics tab. From here you have the ability to display any cosmetic microtransaction you own in its appropriate slot.
records.zhTW:
為此目的，商城中可以購買外觀效果，若你的倉庫空間不足夠，商城也提供許多倉庫擴充的選擇。

外觀效果的選項眾多，有些會代替物品的外型、有些會為你的穿著增加更多特效。有些甚至會完全改變技能的效果。購買後只需要前往道具介面中的外觀分頁即可裝備它們。

records.english: The Cosmetics tab is accessible from the Inventory screen.
records.zhTW: 你可以透過你的道具介面前往外觀分頁。

records.english:
Many players who want to support Path of Exile opt to buy Supporter Packs, which contain points for purchasing microtransactions as well as forum titles, player portrait frames, exclusive cosmetics that are only available from those packs, and more. Each Supporter Pack is only available for a limited time. Once it gets taken off the market, it never returns.
 
If you would like to support us and the continued development of Path of Exile, please consider visiting our Shop.
records.zhTW: 希望支持贊助流亡黯道的玩家可以選擇購買贊助包，一般來說贊助包將包含黯幣、論壇頭銜、角色外框、每期限定的獨家外觀造型，等等更多。每個贊助者包都有上架期限，一旦下架就再也不會重新販售。

records.english:
The Pantheon lets you selectively enhance your character for the dangers that lay ahead. By defeating any of the major or minor gods in Part 2, your character gains access to that god's Pantheon power.

You can have one major and one minor Pantheon power active at any given time. Each Pantheon power only enhances a narrow aspect of your character's survivability, so carefully consider what you are likely to soon face, and select a power that'll best help you.

You can only change which Pantheon powers are active in a Town or Hideout, but doing so is entirely free.
records.zhTW:
眾神殿系統讓你自行選擇強化角色的方式。擊敗任何主神或次神都能解鎖該神的眾神殿能力。

同一時間能夠啟用一個主神和一個次神之力。每一個神之力會提供給你特定的生存能力，評估你接下來將會遇到的敵人並選擇最合適的神之力。

你必須在城鎮或藏身處中才能更換神之力，更換神之力為完全免費的功能。

records.english: At later levels you can upgrade each power, broadening the protection it provides. To do so, you have to obtain a Divine Vessel and put it in your map device, then open a map that contains one of the map bosses displayed on the Pantheon.
records.zhTW: 眾神殿中的能力在後期將可以透過眾神聖器強化，得到更廣泛的防禦能力。將眾神聖器放置在地圖裝置中並開啟眾神殿對應的地圖。

records.english: Once you've defeated the map boss, your filled Divine Vessel will be waiting for you in the map device.
records.zhTW: 擊敗地圖頭目後，你的眾神聖器將會裝滿力量在製圖裝置中等著你取回。

records.english: Although the main storyline ends at Act 10, hundreds (if not thousands!) of hours of fun still lay ahead, by way of a special kind of item called maps.
records.zhTW: 即使流亡黯道的劇情在第十章節完結，輿圖和它的地圖系統還有上百小時(甚至上千小時)的遊戲體驗等著你。

records.english:
Maps are items that open up brand new areas through the Map Device, located in the Epilogue area. High level monsters in the last few Acts can drop the earliest maps, but higher tier maps can only be found within other maps. 

Like other items, maps can be normal, magic, rare or unique, and have a wide pool of mods that affect both the difficulty and reward of the areas they open. Carefully crafting your maps for challenges that suit your build is an important part of Path of Exile's map system. It's always worth checking the mods on a map before you try to complete it. Some of them can be very punishing!
records.zhTW:
地圖道具可以透過置圖裝置開啟全新的地區，最後幾個章節的高等怪物將會掉落最初期的地圖道具，更高等的地圖道具必須在地圖中才有可能掉落。

就像其他物品，地圖道具也分為一般、魔法、稀有和傳奇地圖，並且有整個系列的詞綴能夠影響每張地圖的難度和獎勵。多多留意每張地圖的詞綴，因為有些詞綴可是非常難纏的。

records.english:
You can view which maps you have completed in your Atlas (default hotkey G). You can also further influence the properties of each map by applying a sextant to the Atlas icon. Sextants last for a limited number of maps and affect every map within its radius. While in a map, enemies can drop any maps of a lower tier that you have previously completed, as well as maps of a higher tier that the map you are in is connected to. Map bosses have an especially high chance to drop a map. 

Maps also have a bonus objective; usually to complete the map as a specific rarity. Completing this bonus objective increases the chances of finding higher tier maps. The higher the map tier, however, the harder it is to obtain even higher tier maps.
records.zhTW:
你可以在輿圖中看見你已經完成過的地圖(預設按鍵：G)。透過六分儀你能夠進一步影響每張地圖的屬性，六分儀使用後會給予周遭一定次數的影響。

地圖中的怪物有機會掉落你已經完成的較低等地圖道具，或者與當前地圖相連的更高等地圖道具。地圖頭目掉落地圖道具的機率特別高。

輿圖上每張地圖都會有個特殊目標，一般來說會要求你該地圖特定稀有度的版本。完成特殊條件將會給予你更多獲得更高階地圖的機會。然而，隨著地圖的等級提升，更高階地圖的掉落率也會下降。

records.english:
Later, you'll find Shaper's Orbs which let you upgrade the tier of a map, increasing the difficulty and levels of the monsters within.

Most players aim to work their way towards the centre of the Atlas in the hopes of challenging The Shaper, a very difficult but rewarding boss.
records.zhTW:
往後，你還會找到塑界玉，使用在對應階級的輿圖上可以使該地圖階級提升。

大多流亡者會把目標放在輿圖的中心，望著最後能夠挑戰塑界者，非常困難但也有豐厚獎勵的頭目。

records.english:
Path of Exile features several player-versus-player (or PvP) modes. At the top of the Sarn Encampment is an entrance to Sarn Arena, an area for open, unstructured player-slaying.

Want something more structured? You can duel individual players, or form a team and fight as a group. Path of Exile also supports a Capture the Flag game mode.

There are two main PvP brackets -- Open PvP, which has no limits on player level, and Low Level Dueling (LLD) which is limited to players of level 28 or below.

Leo Redmane in the Sarn Encampment offers daily PvP missions, and rewards active PvPers with Hideout decorations and crafting options, similar to other Forsaken Masters.

Dying in a PvP area on a Hardcore league does not send you to Standard, but if you die to another player outside of a PvP area, such as during the Act 2 Bandit questline, you will be sent to Standard as normal.

Note that special damage scaling rules are in place for PvP to level the playing field to some degree. Even so, the difference in both player skill and gear can be extreme, so don't become discouraged if you get slaughtered on your first try.
records.zhTW:
流亡黯道中提供了多種玩家對玩家(PVP)的遊戲模式。在薩恩城最上方可以進入薩恩競技場，一個開放式的自由對戰區域。

想要更有規則的模式嗎? 你可以和其他玩家單挑，或者組成隊伍進行組隊戰鬥，甚至參加搶旗競賽。

PVP的競賽主要分為兩個類別，開放式PVP：玩家等級無限制，和低等PVP：玩家等級限制在 28 等以下。

薩恩城中的赤焰鬥者里歐，如同大師一樣也會提供流亡者每日PVP任務，用藏身處裝飾品、工藝桌獎勵PVP活躍玩家。

在專家模式中，就算在PVP區域死亡也不會被轉移至一般聯盟。

流亡黯道的PVP存在特殊的傷害修正，以更加平衡PVP體驗，雖然如此玩家的流派和技術差距還是有非常大的差距，所以如果你的第一次被慘電，也不要過於灰心。

records.english:
Path of Exile's customer support team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. If you experience abuse or harassment while playing Path of Exile, you can report the abusive players by right-clicking their name in the chat window, and the support team will investigate the issue.

If you have a question or problem, try searching the Path of Exile forums to see if someone else has had a similar experience that has been resolved before you contact support. If you cannot find a resolution to the problem you are facing, please email support@grindinggear.com.

If you're experiencing payment or microtransaction problems or account issues, please email support@grindinggear.com. Someone will be in contact with you as soon as they can. We aim to have an extremely quick response time, but rest assured if there's any delay we're working to respond as soon as we can.

If you're experiencing technical issues, please try searching the Technical Support section of the Path of Exile forums for possible solutions.
records.zhTW:
若遇到任何遊戲相關的問題建議你可以先至各大論壇查看是否有其他玩家有和你相同的疑問，說不定已經獲得了解答。

如果遭到其他玩家騷擾，遇到了不好的遊戲體驗，你可以右鍵檢舉該玩家，我們的查緝團隊將會調查該玩家的行為。

同時有任何問題皆可以前往 Garena 客服中心尋求協助。

https://tw.support.garena.com/
